_meta.authority: CANONICAL for weapon card text. Design .md docs hold rulings, sim results, and rationale only.
_meta.schemaNote: badges extends beyond POISED|EXHAUST - '2 ACT' (Flail) and 'ON DRAW' (Ritual Knife, Greatbow) are legacy badges in use. Renderer must handle all four.
laws: Phases are never a power tier - a Fast card may carry the set's biggest number.
Budget lives at the SET level - one card of three may hog it.
No card reads enemy HP totals.
Economy-warping effects (future-turn debt, deck growth) are class-tier, not weapon-tier.
Weapons have no sockets and no Encore - they are the die-free / keyword-free fallback.
pendingDecisions: Twin Chakrams: APPROVED re-run with 'draw to 6 ignoring returned Chakrams'. Card text below is the pre-fix locked state - do not print until the re-run settles. Pre-declared trim: Chakram Arc 4 -> 3.
The Gorger: APPROVED re-run with a Gorging-Edge-priority prelude. If median stays under +3, Feed the Blade grants 3 Glut instead of 2.
The Unbound Codex: recommendation is POISED on Chapter III only (cleanup discards write the story for free; holding I and II fights it). Text below keeps POISED on all three pending the call.

weapons.name: Greataxe
weapons.identity: Brutal, swingy burst - big variable hits that spike or whiff, a steady guard to fall back on, and a heavy finisher.

cards.name: Cleave
cards.effect: Deal **1d12** Physical.

cards.name: Heavy Guard
cards.effect: Gain **5** Block.

cards.name: Decapitate
cards.effect: Deal **1d12+5** Physical.

weapons.name: Maul
weapons.identity: Break them, then cash the break - heavy blows that pile on Stagger and a finisher that doubles once a foe is broken.

cards.name: Crush
cards.effect: Deal **1d10** Physical.

cards.name: Stagger Blow
cards.effect: Deal **5** Physical and apply **1 Stagger**.

cards.name: Skullcrack
cards.effect: Deal **1d12+1** Physical. If the target is at or over its Stagger threshold, deal **+1d12**.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.identity: Disciplined reach - three steady, reliable pokes with no wild dice.

cards.name: Skewer
cards.effect: Deal **6** Physical.

cards.name: Keep Distance
cards.effect: Deal **3** Physical and apply **1 Stagger**.

cards.name: Phalanx Set
cards.effect: Deal **4** Physical and gain **3** Block.

weapons.name: Sword & Shield
weapons.identity: The protector - modest reliable damage paired with real block, and a slam that shields an ally.

cards.name: Sword Blow
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+2** Physical.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.effect: Gain **6** Block.

cards.name: Shield Slam
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Physical and give an ally **4** Block.

weapons.name: Daggers
weapons.identity: Quick and relentless - load Empower, then dump it across a flurry of small hits. Weak against armor.

cards.name: Setup Slice
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Physical and gain **Empower 2**.

cards.name: Twin Fangs
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical, **twice**.

cards.name: Coup
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Physical, **three times**. (Empower boosts each hit.)

weapons.name: Crossbow
weapons.identity: Heavy, deliberate shots - a solid bolt, a reload that sharpens aim, and an armor-piercing finisher. Pure offense, no block.

cards.name: Bolt
cards.effect: Deal **1d10** Physical.

cards.name: Reload
cards.effect: Gain **1 Strength** and **1 Focus** this turn.

cards.name: Piercing Bolt
cards.effect: Deal **2d8** Physical, **Piercing** - ignores Armor.

weapons.name: Staff / Focus
weapons.identity: The arcane all-rounder - reliable magic damage, a lasting ward, and an overcharged blast that weakens.

cards.name: Arcane Bolt
cards.effect: Deal **1d10** Magical.

cards.name: Ward
cards.effect: Gain **5** Block and **1 Magic Armor** (Permanent).

cards.name: Overchannel
cards.effect: Deal **2d8** Magical and apply **Weaken 2**.

weapons.name: Wand / Catalyst
weapons.identity: A fire caster's tool - a reliable spark, a kindling flame, and a pyre that flares against a burning foe.

cards.name: Tinder
cards.effect: Deal **5** Magical.

cards.name: Kindle
cards.effect: Apply **Burn** and deal **2** Magical.

cards.name: Pyre
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Magical and apply **Burn**. If the target is already Burning, deal **+1d6**.

weapons.name: Flail
weapons.identity: A gambler's weapon - one all-in swing of pure variance, a sweeping crowd hit, and a self-empowering smash.

cards.name: Mountain's Weight
cards.effect: Deal **1d20** Physical. Costs **2 actions** (any). Resolves at Slow.

cards.name: Flail Around
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical to **ALL** enemies.

cards.name: Crunch & Shatter
cards.effect: Deal **3** Physical. You gain **+1 Strength/Focus** this turn.

weapons.name: Censer
weapons.identity: A caster's support tool - build focus, shield an ally, choke a foe with toxic smoke.

cards.name: Invigorating Miasma
cards.effect: Gain **2 Focus** this turn.

cards.name: Create Cover
cards.effect: Gain **1d10+1** Block.

cards.name: Toxins Abound
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Magical and apply **2 Poison**.

weapons.name: Cursed Mask
weapons.identity: A weapon of perception and dread - see the perfect strike, unnerve a foe, read an ally's intent.

cards.name: Unnatural Vision
cards.effect: Gain **Precise** for one attack this turn (rolls its **max** die).

cards.name: Unnerving Gaze
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+1** Magical.

cards.name: Read Thoughts
cards.effect: That ally gains **Empower 2**.

weapons.name: Ritual Knife
weapons.identity: Blood magic that bypasses armor - pierce the soul, spend your own blood for power, feed the blade to bend your timing.

cards.name: Pierce Soul
cards.effect: Deal **1d4+1** Magical **Piercing**, **twice**.

cards.name: Blood Sacrifice
cards.effect: Take **1d4+2** Magical **Piercing**. Gain **+2 Strength and Focus** next turn.

cards.name: The Blade Yearns for Blood
cards.effect: Take **1d4** Magical **Piercing**. Change one timing slot to **ANY** this turn.

weapons.name: Channeling Brush
weapons.identity: Paint life or shadow - a lingering heal, a staggering spiral of void, a withering sight.

cards.name: Lush Landscape
cards.effect: Heal **2** and apply **Regen 2**.

cards.name: Darkening Spiral
cards.effect: Deal **3** Magical and apply **1 Stagger**.

cards.name: Vile Sight
cards.effect: Deal **2d6** Magical and apply **Weaken 1**.

weapons.name: Frost Wand
weapons.identity: A chilling control weapon - stagger with frost, cash the freeze when the threshold breaks, shell up behind crystal.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.effect: Deal **1d10** Magical and apply **1 Stagger**.

cards.name: Freezing Shatter
cards.effect: Apply **1 Stagger** and deal **2d6** Magical. If the Stagger threshold is met this turn, deal **+2d6**.

cards.name: Crystal Shell
cards.effect: Gain **1 Armor**, then gain **2d4** Block.

weapons.name: Greatbow
weapons.identity: Charge and release - bank arrows as Persistent tokens outside your deck, then loose them all at once.

cards.name: Unleash Arrow
cards.effect: Deal **1d10**, **+4** for each Persistent arrow. Then sacrifice all arrows.

cards.name: Prepare Arrow
cards.effect: Becomes a **Persistent arrow token** (out of deck). Does nothing until Unleash fires.

cards.name: Prepare Arrow
cards.effect: Becomes a **Persistent arrow token** (out of deck). Does nothing until Unleash fires.

weapons.name: Chains
weapons.identity: A reactive weapon that cheats extra plays - Reacts cost no timing slot, paid for with lower numbers and hand pressure.

cards.name: Draining Grasp
cards.effect: Deal **1d4+1** Magical. Heal yourself for the same amount.

cards.name: Set Up
cards.effect: Deal **1d6**.

cards.name: Drain Strength
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Magical. The enemy loses **1 Strength and Focus** (1 turn); you gain **1 Strength and Focus** (1 turn).

weapons.name: Arquebus
weapons.identity: One thunderclap, then housekeeping - hold the shot POISED, hunt the reload, let the bayonet keep you honest.

cards.name: Thunder Barrel
cards.effect: Playable only while the Arquebus is **Loaded**: deal **2d10** Physical. It becomes **Unloaded**.

cards.name: Ramrod & Powder
cards.effect: **Load** the Arquebus. Gain **2** Block.

cards.name: Bayonet Brace
cards.effect: Deal **1d6+2** Physical.

weapons.name: War Banner
weapons.identity: A weapon you plant, not swing - the standard turns every order into an echo.

cards.name: Plant the Standard
cards.effect: Place in your Persistent zone: each maintenance (beneficial step), every ally including you heals **1**. Unique; cannot be attacked; out of your deck while planted.

cards.name: Rally Behind Me
cards.effect: Give **4** Block. While the Standard is planted: **repeat this**, same or different target.

cards.name: Hold the Line!
cards.effect: Give one ally **Empower 3** this turn. While the Standard is planted: **repeat this**, same or different ally.

weapons.name: Flensing Blades
weapons.identity: Open the vein and let the whole party drink - the Bleed carrier.

cards.name: Flensing Cut
cards.effect: Deal **1d4+1** Physical and apply **Bleed**.

cards.name: Peel
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Physical; **+3** if the target is **Bleeding**.

cards.name: Open Every Vein
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Physical, **4 times**.

weapons.name: The Unbound Codex
weapons.identity: A story told in order - write the chapters into the discard one by one, then end the book.

cards.name: Chapter I - Kindling
cards.effect: Deal **4** Magical.

cards.name: Chapter II - Rising Storm
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical; **+4** if Chapter I is in your discard pile.

cards.name: Chapter III - The Unmaking
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical; if Chapters I **and** II are both in your discard pile: deal **3d8** instead.

weapons.name: Retiarius
weapons.identity: Net first, trident second - reads committed intents and punishes the foe who wound up a heavy blow.

cards.name: Cast the Net
cards.effect: Apply **1 Stagger**; **2 Stagger** instead if the target has a committed **Slow** action this round.

cards.name: Trident Thrust
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+1** Physical.

cards.name: No Escape
cards.effect: Deal **2d6** Physical, **+1d6 per Stagger** currently on the target (max +3d6).

weapons.name: Twin Chakrams
weapons.identity: They always come back - three blades that never touch your discard, taxing your hand instead.

cards.name: Chakram Arc
cards.effect: Deal **4** Physical. **Returns to your hand** instead of discarding.

cards.name: Split Throw
cards.effect: Deal **2** Physical to each of **two** different enemies. **Returns to your hand**.

cards.name: The Long Curve
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical to one enemy and **2** to another. **Returns to your hand**.

weapons.name: Siegebreaker Pick
weapons.identity: Armor is a suggestion - chip it away for good, punish anyone who wears it, schedule the round the wall comes down.

cards.name: Sunder Plate
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Physical; reduce the target's **Armor by 1** for the rest of combat (min 0).

cards.name: Crack the Shell
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+1** Physical; **1d12+2** instead if the target has any Armor or Bulwark.

cards.name: Bring Down the Wall
cards.effect: Deal **1d12** Physical, **Piercing**. The target's Armor is reduced by **2** for the whole of **next round**.

weapons.name: The Gorger
weapons.identity: Feed it your dead draws - every exhausted card becomes permanent Glut.

cards.name: Feed the Blade
cards.effect: **Exhaust** a card from your hand (removed for this combat): the Gorger gains **2 Glut** (max 6).

cards.name: Gorging Edge
cards.effect: Deal **1d4 + Glut** Physical.

cards.name: Disgorge
cards.effect: Deal **1d6 + 2 per Glut** Physical.

weapons.name: Navigator's Sextant
weapons.identity: Knowledge instead of luck - fish the bottom of your deck, rig the top, cash the reveal.

cards.name: Chart the Stars
cards.effect: Look at the **bottom 3** cards of your deck. **Play one of them** in this card's place (any printed timing); return the rest to the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Guiding Star
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical. You may first look at your deck's **top card** and put it on the **bottom**.

cards.name: Read the Heavens
cards.effect: **Reveal** the top card of your deck: deal **5** Magical; **9** if it is a **Slow** card.

weapons.name: Sunblade & Moonblade
weapons.identity: Two blades, one turn - hold both POISED, sacrifice the draws, wait for the eclipse.

cards.name: Sunblade
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical. **Eclipse:** if you play Moonblade this turn, **+3**.

cards.name: Moonblade
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical and heal yourself **2**. **Eclipse:** if you play Sunblade this turn, **+3**.

cards.name: Total Eclipse
cards.effect: Deal **2d6+2** Physical; **3d6+3** instead if you played **both blades** this turn.

weapons.name: Puppeteer's Strings
weapons.identity: Every read at the top of the round - redirect the blow, fray the string, weaken the arm.

cards.name: Tug the Line
cards.effect: Deal **1d4+1** Magical and apply **Weaken 1**.

cards.name: Marionette
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Magical; one enemy's committed attack this round targets **you** instead.

cards.name: Fray the Strings
cards.effect: Choose one enemy's committed, unresolved action this round: it deals **half damage** (rounded down) when it resolves.

weapons.name: Poisoner's Toolkit
weapons.identity: Doesn't apply the plague - conducts it. Copy conditions across the field, pull ticks forward, harvest the soup.

cards.name: Vector
cards.effect: Deal **2** Magical. **Copy** one Bleed, Burn, or Poison from the target onto **another enemy** (at its current value).

cards.name: Aggravate
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Magical. The target's Poison and Burn **tick immediately** (advancing them). If it has neither, apply **Poison 2**.

cards.name: Symptom's End
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Magical, **+3 for each different condition** on the target (Bleed, Burn, Poison, Weaken, Stagger; max +9).

weapons.name: Duelist's Rapier
weapons.identity: Reads your own blood - sharpest when pristine, deadliest when cornered, ordinary in between.

cards.name: Pristine Form
cards.effect: Deal **1d6+1** Physical; **+3** if you are at **full HP**.

cards.name: High Guard, Low Cut
cards.effect: **Above half HP:** gain **4** Block and apply **Weaken 1** to one enemy. **At or below half:** deal **1d6+3** Physical.

cards.name: Desperate Lunge
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Physical; **+4** if you are **below half HP**.

weapons.name: Grudgekeeper
weapons.identity: The mirror remembers - catch the worst blow you took and hand it back, in kind and in type.

cards.name: Catch the Blow
cards.target: React - an enemy's hit damages you
cards.effect: Gain **2** Block. Record the **post-mitigation** HP damage taken as your **Grudge** (one stored; a new one replaces the old).

cards.name: Return to Sender
cards.effect: Deal damage equal to your **Grudge**, in its original type (max **12**). Clear it.

cards.name: Spiteful Edge
cards.effect: Deal **3** Physical; **+3** if a Grudge is stored.

weapons.name: Lifespring Gauntlets
weapons.identity: Every heal is a downpayment on violence - being mended charges the gauntlets.

cards.name: Drink Deep
cards.target: React - when you are healed (1x / round)
cards.effect: Gain **1 Vitality** (max 3). Regen ticks and item heals both count.

cards.name: Surging Fist
cards.effect: Deal **1d6+1** Physical. You may spend all Vitality: **+2 per Vitality** spent.

cards.name: Font of Strength
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical and heal yourself **2**.

weapons.name: Ricochet Sling
weapons.identity: Cheap damage, wild trajectories - the dice pick the victims.

cards.name: Skipping Stone
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical; then **3** Physical to a **random other** enemy.

cards.name: Chaos Bounce
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Physical; then **1d4** to a **random other** enemy, **twice**.

cards.name: Bank Shot
cards.effect: Deal **3d6** Physical to a **random** enemy.

weapons.name: Grindstone Falx
weapons.identity: Patience is the edge - every reshuffle sharpens it, every mill hurries the clock.

cards.name: Whetted Strike
cards.effect: Deal **4** Physical, **+2 per time your deck has reshuffled** this combat.

cards.name: Grind On
cards.effect: Heal yourself **3**. **Mill 5:** put the top 5 cards of your deck into your discard pile. (Mills never fire when-drawn or Encore effects.)

cards.name: The Patient Edge
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical, **+3 per reshuffle** this combat.

weapons.name: Hatchets
weapons.identity: flexibility & spread

cards.name: Hack
cards.effect: Deal 1d4 Physical damage, twice.

cards.name: Thrown Hatchet
cards.effect: Deal 4 Physical Damage

cards.name: Both Blades
cards.effect: Deal 3 Physical damage to each of two different enemies. If there is only one enemy instead deal 1d12+1 Physical.

weapons.name: Militia Spear
weapons.identity: safe damage

cards.name: Spear Thrust
cards.effect: Deal 1d6+2 Physical damage.

cards.name: Brace
cards.effect: Gain 5 block

cards.name: Set Against the Charge
cards.effect: Deal 4 damage to an enemy and gain 2 block.

weapons.name: Bill Hook
weapons.identity: Hook, pull & finish

cards.name: Hook & pull
cards.effect: Deal 3 damage and apply 1 stagger

cards.name: Bill Chop
cards.effect: Deal 1d8+1 Physical

cards.name: Drag Them Down
cards.effect: Deal 1d6 Physical; +3 if enemy has any stagger.

weapons.name: Arming Sword
weapons.identity: asks nothing of you

cards.name: Cut
cards.effect: Deal 1d8+1 Physical damage.

cards.name: Thrust
cards.effect: Deal 1d10 Physical damage.

cards.name: Guard
cards.effect: Deal 2 Physical damage and gain 4 Block.

weapons.name: Long-Knife
weapons.identity: multi-hit

cards.name: Quick Cut
cards.effect: Deal 1d4 Physical Damage, twice.

cards.name: Long Reach
cards.effect: Deal 1d6+1 damage

cards.name: Flurry
cards.effect: Deal 2 damage, three times.

weapons.name: Buckler & Blade
weapons.identity: stand in front

cards.name: Buckler Punch
cards.effect: Deal 3 Physical and gain 3 Block.

cards.name: Cover Him
cards.effect: Give them 5 Block.

cards.name: Riposte
cards.effect: Deal 1d8+1 Physical.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.identity: through the plate

cards.name: Bolt
cards.effect: Deal 1d8+1 Physical.

cards.name: Punch Through

weapons.name: Arquebus

cards.name: Thunder Barrel

cards.name: Ramrod & Powder
cards.effect: **Load** the Arquebus. Gain **2** Block.

cards.name: Bayonet Brace
cards.effect: Deal **1d6+2** Physical.

weapons.name: War Banner
weapons.identity: A weapon you plant, not swing - the standard turns every order into an echo.

cards.name: Plant the Standard
cards.effect: Place in your Persistent zone: each maintenance (beneficial step), every ally including you heals **1**. Unique; cannot be attacked; out of your deck while planted.

cards.name: Rally Behind Me
cards.effect: Give **4** Block. While the Standard is planted: **repeat this**, same or different target.

cards.name: Hold the Line!
cards.effect: Give one ally **Empower 3** this turn. While the Standard is planted: **repeat this**, same or different ally.

weapons.name: Flensing Blades
weapons.identity: Open the vein and let the whole party drink - the Bleed carrier.

cards.name: Flensing Cut
cards.effect: Deal **1d4+1** Physical and apply **Bleed**.

cards.name: Peel
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Physical; **+3** if the target is **Bleeding**.

cards.name: Open Every Vein
cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Physical, **4 times**.

weapons.name: The Unbound Codex
weapons.identity: A story told in order - write the chapters into the discard one by one, then end the book.

cards.name: Chapter I - Kindling
cards.effect: Deal **4** Magical.

cards.name: Chapter II - Rising Storm
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical; **+4** if Chapter I is in your discard pile.

cards.name: Chapter III - The Unmaking
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical; if Chapters I **and** II are both in your discard pile: deal **3d8** instead.

weapons.name: Retiarius
weapons.identity: Net first, trident second - reads committed intents and punishes the foe who wound up a heavy blow.

cards.name: Cast the Net

cards.name: Trident Thrust
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+1** Physical.

cards.name: No Escape
cards.effect: Deal **2d6** Physical, **+1d6 per Stagger** currently on the target (max +3d6).

cards.effect: Deal **4** Physical. **Returns to your hand** instead of discarding.

cards.effect: Deal **2** Physical to each of **two** different enemies. **Returns to your hand**.

cards.name: The Long Curve
cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Physical to one enemy and **2** to another. **Returns to your hand**.

weapons.identity: Armor is a suggestion - chip it away for good, punish anyone who wears it, schedule the round the wall comes down.

cards.name: Crack the Shell
cards.effect: Deal **1d8+1** Physical; **1d12+2** instead if the target has any Armor or Bulwark.

cards.name: Bring Down the Wall
cards.effect: Deal **1d12** Physical, **Piercing**. The target's Armor is reduced by **2** for the whole of **next round**.

cards.name: Gorging Edge
cards.effect: Deal **1d4 + Glut** Physical.

cards.name: Disgorge
cards.effect: Deal **1d6 + 2 per Glut** Physical.

weapons.identity: Knowledge instead of luck - fish the bottom of your deck, rig the top, cash the reveal.

cards.effect: Look at the **bottom 3** cards of your deck. **Play one of them** in this card's place (any printed timing); return the rest to the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Guiding Star
cards.effect: Deal **1d8** Magical. You may first look at your deck's **top card** and put it on the **bottom**.

cards.name: Read the Heavens
cards.effect: **Reveal** the top card of your deck: deal **5** Magical; **9** if it is a **Slow** card.

cards.name: Moonblade

cards.name: Total Eclipse
cards.effect: Deal **2d6+2** Physical; **3d6+3** instead if you played **both blades** this turn.

cards.effect: Deal **1d6** Magical. The target's Poison and Burn **tick immediately** (advancing them). If it has neither, apply **Poison 2**.

cards.effect: Deal **1d4** Magical, **+3 for each different condition** on the target (Bleed, Burn, Poison, Weaken, Stagger; max +9).

cards.name: Desperate Lunge

cards.name: Spiteful Edge
